description: Numeric-bounds-only $defs (minimum/maximum only — no type/default, those stay per-field since defaults occasionally differ even when the range doesn't, e.g. pressure_h_pa's 1013.0 default in profiles.schema.json's Zero vs. 1013.25 in settings.schema.json's ShootingConditions/VelocityConv) shared across profiles.schema.json and settings.schema.json via bin/embed_schema.dart's mergeDefsFrom — the same cross-file merge-at-embed-time mechanism ebcp.schema.json already uses for its own $refs, so no source file hand-duplicates a $defs entry it doesn't itself own. Every usage composes one of these via allOf plus its own sibling type/default: {"allOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/TemperatureC"}], "type": "number", "default": ...}. Fields whose bounds only ever repeat within a single schema file keep their shared $defs local to that file instead of here (see profiles.schema.json's CaliberInch/SightHeightInch/BallisticCoefficient/MagnificationBounds, or settings.schema.json's DistanceStepMeter/TableRangeMeter).

TemperatureC.description: FC.temperature, celsius (-100–100). Shared by profiles.schema.json's Zero/Ammo temperature fields and settings.schema.json's ShootingConditions/VelocityConv ones.

AltitudeMeter.description: FC.altitude, meter (-500–15000). Shared by profiles.schema.json's Zero.altitude_meter and settings.schema.json's ShootingConditions/VelocityConv altitude fields.

PressureHPa.description: FC.pressure, hPa (300–1500). Shared by profiles.schema.json's Zero.pressure_h_pa and settings.schema.json's ShootingConditions/VelocityConv pressure fields.

HumidityFrac.description: FC.humidity, fraction (0–1). Shared by profiles.schema.json's Zero.humidity_frac and settings.schema.json's ShootingConditions/VelocityConv humidity fields.

LatitudeDeg.description: FC.latitude, degree (-90–90). Shared by profiles.schema.json's Zero.latitude_deg and settings.schema.json's ShootingConditions.latitude_deg.

AzimuthDeg.description: FC.azimuth, degree (0–360). Shared by profiles.schema.json's Zero.azimuth_deg and settings.schema.json's ShootingConditions.azimuth_deg.

LookAngleRad.description: FC.lookAngle, degree→radian (-90°..90°). Shared by profiles.schema.json's Zero.look_angle_rad and settings.schema.json's ShootingConditions.look_angle_rad.
